text: B1e opened: the scheme standing. Startup packet read: head (2,922 words), stage file, last five diary entries, scheme --brief (197 themes, 13,432 placements, three pages), validate.py --open B1 (0 errors, 0 warnings). The second pass stopped at B1d-07 (108 of 108 chosen rooms; run 108 rooms and 148.1 average rooms against 78 and 72.1). This leg writes scheme.md, scheme.jsonl, families.jsonl and confusions.md (stage file sections 3 to 5), the hand-over checks (section 7), handback-B1.md, the interview brief out/interview/B1e.md, and closes with done.sh B1 --cut interview. Plan: first read the validator's checks for the shipped files, prior.md's exemplar rule and the contract's rules on gates; then group the 197 themes into families; then write each family's gates, discriminators and exemplars from the members' second-order themes and concepts, saving each family to a draft file as it is done.

B1e families drafted: out/_analysis/b1e_families.tsv, 21 families over all 197 themes (G01 April Fools in the sub, 9; G02 the sub's rules and usual posts, 11; G03 where the planning happens, 11; G04 calling people in to place, 8; G05 telling placers what to place, 9; G06 strain, doubt and giving up, 8; G07 choosing what to make and where, 12; G08 building and growing the mark, 11; G09 defending and repairing the work, 7; G10 finding who changed the work, 9; G11 scripts, bots and extra accounts, 8; G12 attacking others' work, 7; G13 holding back from others' work, 8; G14 space and help between rooms, 10; G15 pacts and envoys between rooms, 13; G16 kindred rooms and colour factions, 9; G17 nations and their flags, 8; G18 politics, history and hate symbols, 10; G19 taunts and victories over rivals, 6; G20 looking at the canvas and its worth, 10; G21 after the canvas closed, 13). A family is an index of themes a reader would confuse; it may change as the gates are written. Working method in out/_analysis/b1e_method.md; helpers b1e_digest.py (theme digest through mem.py scheme) and b1e_cands.py (exemplar candidates through cite.py: the rule 0 lines' concepts, then a seeded sample, seed 20261011). Next: family G01.

B1e family G01 (April Fools in the sub) drafted: out/_analysis/b1e_draft_G01.jsonl, 9 themes (T3-001, T3-023, T3-032, T3-048, T3-064, T3-093, T3-095, T3-097, T3-100), every field, 27 exemplars quoted through cite.py and checked with out/_analysis/b1e_check_draft.py (0 problems). Seven names changed to meet 2 to 5 words or the head's B1e list: T3-023 running an April Fools takeover (the sub's takeover, not only its moderators, and one sub's joke raid on another); T3-032 objecting to April Fools posts; T3-048 reacting to official April Fools (a company's, organisation's or creator's own); T3-064 spreading the room's joke elsewhere; T3-093 playing with granted moderator powers; T3-095 testing others' April Fools claims; T3-097 switching off the prank styling; T3-100 keeping April Fools changes afterwards. Tier lines for the relabels are written at assembly. Exemplar candidates: the seeded sample through cite.py held few quotes that pass a gate alone, and cite.py's --grep matched member labels, so candidates now come from mem.py codes --third, shuffled with seed 20261011 and, where the gate's own words help, filtered by them (out/_analysis/b1e_cands.py --pat); each chosen quote is then quoted through cite.py. Next: family G02.

B1e family G02 (the sub's rules and usual posts) drafted: out/_analysis/b1e_draft_G02.jsonl, 11 themes (T3-015, T3-017, T3-051, T3-063, T3-075, T3-106, T3-110, T3-133, T3-140, T3-184, T3-185); exemplars quoted through cite.py and checked. Two themes carry fewer than three exemplars because their members hold fewer passing quotes: T3-110 two (pgang c0002, france c0394; livecounting's concepts count alts, not tiles traded) and T3-184 one (coldplay c0075; kanye's only concept, c0313, does not show the pause on its own). Names changed: T3-015 routing canvas posts into megathreads; T3-017 carrying on ordinary sub talk; T3-051 pushing posts up the rankings (vote drives for canvas posts and for search results); T3-063 removing canvas posts by rule; T3-075 objecting to the canvas flood; T3-106 calling a network boycott; T3-110 placing a tile as payment; T3-133 recovering a hacked sub. Next: family G03.

B1e family G03 (where the planning happens) drafted: out/_analysis/b1e_draft_G03.jsonl, 10 themes (T3-014, T3-049, T3-090, T3-107, T3-109, T3-114, T3-116, T3-132, T3-152, T3-153), 30 exemplars through cite.py, checked (0 problems). T3-111 (giving the canvas sub a new purpose) moved from G03 to G21 in out/_analysis/b1e_families.tsv: its near neighbours are T3-054 and T3-158, after the canvas. Names changed: T3-014 moving planning into a chat (Discord, IRC, Skype, Telegram, Slack); T3-090 opening a canvas sub; T3-107 keeping planning in the thread; T3-109 arguing which chat to use; T3-114 disputing the chat's authority; T3-116 hiding the plan from rivals; T3-132 spying in a rival's chat. Next: family G04.

B1e family G04 (calling people in to place) drafted: out/_analysis/b1e_draft_G04.jsonl, 8 themes (T3-002, T3-044, T3-062, T3-104, T3-129, T3-144, T3-159, T3-196), 24 exemplars through cite.py, checked (0 problems). T3-002's gate now says calls to placers who are not yet a group are included (the B1d-07 note from rainbowgrid t02). T3-044's gate carries the T3-044/T3-082 discriminator written at B1d-07. One name changed: T3-044 recruiting canvas visitors. Exemplar quotes that name members by user name were trimmed to substrings without the names (HomestarRunner c0143, paydaytheheist c0011). Next: family G05.

B1e family G05 (telling placers what to place) drafted: out/_analysis/b1e_draft_G05.jsonl, 9 themes (T3-034, T3-066, T3-070, T3-091, T3-101, T3-103, T3-125, T3-141, T3-167), 27 exemplars through cite.py, checked (0 problems). T3-070's gate now includes plans of colours, borders and timings (the B1d-05 note from france t05); T3-125's discriminator against T3-188 follows the B1d-01 tier line (polska t10). Names changed: T3-066 putting decisions to a vote; T3-091 keeping everyone on one template; T3-103 dividing the picture among teams; T3-125 saying the room wings it. Next: family G06.

B1e family G06 (strain, doubt and giving up) drafted: out/_analysis/b1e_draft_G06.jsonl, 8 themes (T3-036, T3-059, T3-074, T3-098, T3-123, T3-124, T3-136, T3-181), 24 exemplars through cite.py, checked (0 problems). The B1d-06 T3-074/T3-136 discriminator is written into both gates; the glitch question the head left open is settled in T3-074's decide_when_both: explaining how the canvas or a glitch works is T3-016, using a glitch to place beyond the limit is T3-088, coping with a glitch that stops or delays placing is T3-074 (so nyjets t13, testing no-cooldown pixels, sits at the T3-074/T3-088 line). Names changed: T3-036 judging the canvas too full; T3-059 urging others to give up; T3-074 working around the timer; T3-123 refusing to give up space; T3-124 weighing fighting against moving; T3-136 doubting the room's strength. Next: family G07.

B1e family G07 (choosing what to make and where) drafted: out/_analysis/b1e_draft_G07.jsonl, 10 themes (T3-004, T3-020, T3-033, T3-055, T3-077, T3-092, T3-160, T3-169, T3-191, T3-197), checked; T3-191 has two exemplars (its one room holds two passing quotes). Family index changes: T3-053 (spelling slogans with post titles) moved to G02 beside T3-051, and its line was added to b1e_draft_G02.jsonl (two exemplars, hearthstone c0229 and c0075; the leagueoflegends letters do not pass alone); T3-148 (imagining art the canvas missed) moved to G21 beside T3-029 and T3-117. T3-077's third exemplar is PlaceNL c0087, the second room's concept the B1d-06 floor note named; that concept's theme is not placed in T3-077, so the theme stays rare. Names changed: T3-020 choosing a canvas spot; T3-033 proposing the room's mark; T3-077 animating the mark in timelapse; T3-053 spelling slogans with post titles. Next: family G08.

B1e family G08 (building and growing the mark) drafted: out/_analysis/b1e_draft_G08.jsonl, 10 themes (T3-003, T3-026, T3-038, T3-041, T3-042, T3-060, T3-069, T3-082, T3-175, T3-187), 30 exemplars through cite.py, checked (0 problems). T3-171 (spreading a colour over the canvas) moved from G08 to G16: its members are colour factions and its rule 0 partners sit beside T3-174. The owed T3-003/T3-038 discriminator is written: one member's share against the room's mark. T3-041 now carries adding pieces to the work or enlarging it, as the head listed. Names changed: T3-026 announcing the mark is up; T3-038 building and reporting the mark; T3-041 extending the room's work; T3-060 adding a personal piece; T3-082 finding the room's mark placed; T3-187 handing the work over. Next: family G09.

B1e family G09 (defending and repairing the work) drafted: out/_analysis/b1e_draft_G09.jsonl, 6 themes (T3-005, T3-007, T3-008, T3-021, T3-022, T3-139), checked; T3-007 has two exemplars, sixers c0054 and parahumans c0007 (the second room's concept the B1d-06 floor note named, in a bag only, so T3-007 stays rare). T3-099 (counting on a bigger neighbour's protection) moved from G09 to G14: its rule 0 partners are T3-010 bags. Names changed: T3-021 watching and repairing the work; T3-022 relocating after losing the spot. Next: family G10.

B1e family G10 (finding who changed the work) drafted: out/_analysis/b1e_draft_G10.jsonl, 8 themes (T3-058, T3-087, T3-118, T3-121, T3-126, T3-170, T3-188, T3-192), 24 exemplars through cite.py, checked (0 problems). T3-189 (fearing newcomers the mark draws) moved to G04 beside T3-044 and its line added to b1e_draft_G04.jsonl. The gate question carried since B1d-02 is ruled in T3-188's decide_when_both: an outside room's denial counts when it separates its organised members from placers acting in its name (Fez's Danish members, CKCrusaders' Norwegian ally); a bare 'it was not us' pointing to another room is tracing (T3-087); members doubting a damage was the room's own also trace it (TheFarLeftSide c0422, c0497). T3-188's name now says what the head listed (separating the plan from placers it cannot control): disowning placers outside the plan. T3-121's name says sanctioning by exclusion: excluding the room's own vandals. T3-087's name says the work, not only pixels: tracing who changed the work, a call's sender included. T3-126 includes saying no one can speak for the placers (the B1d-07 note). T3-192 includes the room's own work. Other names: T3-058 blaming attackers after the close; T3-118 blaming moderators for a loss; T3-126 disputing who speaks for rooms. Next: family G11.
